note: Throat swelling after a sting is anaphylaxis, not a blocked airway.

note: Wild animal bite with rabies risk.

note: Embedded object: leave it in and pad around it.

note: Heavy bleeding with shock signs; the sweating is not heat.

q: my brother cut his foot on coral 2 days ago, now fever, hes cold and pale, barely peeing and kinda confused
note: Infected wound progressing to septic shock.

q: grabbed the pot right out of the campfire, my palm is white and leathery and weirdly doesnt hurt much
note: Deep burn; white skin here is not frostbite so rewarming advice misleads.

note: Complete airway obstruction in a child.

q: found an old man face down in the hotel pool, pulled him out, not breathing
note: Drowning without breathing needs CPR; abdominal thrusts to expel water are harmful.

q: dad on the cruise ship, chest feels crushed, cant catch his breath and his left arm is tingly
note: Heart attack signs; abdominal thrusts would harm.

note: HAPE at altitude, not an airway blockage.

my 4 yo ate some shiny red berries off a bush at the campground not sure what they are
note: Possible plant poisoning in a child.

q: camp stove running inside the tent cause of the rain, we all have pounding headaches and feel sick
note: CO buildup from a stove in an enclosed tent.
